description:
# Experience Tall Ships from the Water: 90-Minute or 60-Minute Harbor Cruise on Northern Lights

Step aboard Boston’s most elegant two-deck yacht for a truly elevated vantage point of the most spectacular maritime gathering of the year. On this 90-minute or 60-minute cruise, you’ll glide out from Rowes Wharf into Boston Harbor, while the wind and skyline set the scene for the extraordinary fleet arriving for Sail Boston® 2026.

Why this cruise is the perfect way to enjoy the action

The Northern Lights features two full decks — enjoy the comfort and sophistication of an interior climate-controlled salon plus an open-air upper deck with panoramic views. Whether you prefer lounging inside with cocktails or stepping out for fresh air and photo ops, you’ll have the best of both worlds.

Avoid the land-based crowds. While the waterfront will be buzzing and congested, you’ll be on the water, moving with the action, with sweeping views of ships, harbor passages, and the Boston skyline.

With a full bar offering drinks and snacks for purchase, you can relax, mingle, and treat yourself or your guests to a premium experience in a casual, inviting setting.

Perfect timing: Enjoy “golden hour” light when the rigging, sails, and masts glow against the evening sky — and you’ll have a front-row seat for the tall-ship lineup without battling the crowds on land.

# About the Tall Ship Celebration

Sail Boston® 2026 (July 11–16, 2026) is Boston’s official participation in the global Sail250® celebration, marking the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. A fleet of majestic international tall ships and naval vessels will arrive from around the world, creating one of the most impressive maritime spectacles in the nation.

# Select Visiting Vessels

* Amerigo Vespucci – Italy
* Bluenose II – Canada
* Cisne Branco – Brazil
* Juan Sebastián de Elcano – Spain
* Esmeralda – Chile
* Dar Młodzieży – Poland
* Denis Sullivan – USA

…and many more from across the globe.

# Why This Cruise Is the Smart Ticket

Premium vantage point: Get spectacular views of the tall ships without the hassle of dockside crowds or standing on narrow piers.

Comfort & convenience: The two-deck design means indoor comfort and outdoor deck access — perfect for groups, families, or corporate outings.

Memorable experience: The combination of historic tall ships, the Boston Harbor sunset, cocktails, and the refined surroundings of the Northern Lights make for an unforgettable outing.

Relaxed & social: The lounge-style interior is perfect for mingling, while the open-air deck offers stunning photo opportunities.

Stress-free: We handle the sailing — you simply show up, sip, and enjoy.

##About Northern Lights  
A Coast Guard Certified Captains and extremely friendly and knowledgeable crew who are trained to help in the event of an emergency operate Northern Lights. The motor yacht Northern Lights is stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamships. She is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor. Northern Lights is 115-feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the ship for up to 149 passengers. She is built for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. Thus, she is excellent for taking out groups of friends and family to see the harbor. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled (heating and air conditioning) cabin or enjoy the sea breeze on our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck to purchase refreshments.
